These pages are controlled integration fixtures, not website content. They fix
the seeds, policies, contexts and question identities needed to exercise grading,
hint progression, inherited policies, cancellation and evidence boundaries.

Keep editorial wording, layout and example ordering checks out of functional
tests. Published pages have separate render and browser smoke checks; their card
counts come from their authored blocks, and corpus counts come from its manifest
and deployed XML. Exact assertions remain appropriate for mathematical results,
source preservation and these deliberately configured test policies.
